snippet: "County Parcels - Public View" is a revised version of the "County Parcels" feature layer which has been sanitized to remove fields containing confidential information including the parcel owner and owner mailing address, so that it may be included in public facing web maps and applications. Parcel lines are not survey grade data and may not accurately reflect legal description. Official information concerning the size or use of any parcel should be obtained from recorded documents and local governing agencies.
